from z3 import *
import time
start = time.time()
weeks = 5
groups = 7
players = 21
group_size = 3

# x[w][p] = group of player p in week w
x = [[Int(f'x_{w}_{p}') for p in range(players)] for w in range(weeks)]

s = Solver()

# domains
for w in range(weeks):
    for p in range(players):
        s.add(x[w][p] >= 0, x[w][p] < groups)

# each week, each group has exactly 3 players
for w in range(weeks):
    for g in range(groups):
        s.add(Sum([If(x[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(players)]) == group_size)

# any two players together at most once
for p1 in range(players):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, players):
        together = Sum([If(x[w][p1] == x[w][p2], 1, 0) for w in range(weeks)])
        s.add(together <= 1)

print(s.check())
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    solution = []
    for w in range(weeks):
        for p in range(players):
            solution.append(m[x[w][p]].as_long())
    print(solution)
print("Time:", time.time() - start)
